notes:
Summary: enterprise fintech (portfolio analytics & live support) evaluating Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput and strict latency SLOs. Priority: deterministic tail latency for customer-facing chat + nightly batch embeddings for search/reranking. Key ask: committed GPU pool sizing, autoscaling behavior under payroll/market-open bursts, and contractual SLA language for p99/p95 latencies.

POC highlights (Dec-Jan):
- Ran 2-week POC on m40-like heavy sequence mix (avg seq 512, spikes to 2048).
- Baseline: 6x A100-equivalent GPUs delivered ~180 reqs/s at p95 gen latency 320ms (single-model variant, fp16).
- Observed variance: 2 out of 15 stress windows showed p95 jump to 620ms due to cold-starts when routing to new workers.
- Embedding throughput: ~12k embeddings/minute across a 4-GPU warm cluster.

Autoscaling & capacity management requirements called out by engineering: 
- Scale-up policy: immediate add of warm node within 45-90s for sustained >60s over-threshold load; allow controlled burst routing to fallback instances during spin-up.
- Warm pools: require a 10% warm pool of reserved GPUs per cluster (min 2 GPUs) to avoid cold-start behavior for chat SLOs.
- Scale-down policy: gentle ramp-down with 10 minute cooldown and staggered drain to avoid KV cache loss; prefer scale-to-zero only for non-latency-critical batch jobs.
- Queueing behavior: allow short queuing (max 15s) for recommendations reranking; for chat the queue budget must be <3s at p95.
- Multi-tier routing: serve critical customers from pinned high-priority lane (dedicated pool) with prewarmed cache; noncritical from cost-optimized lane that can auto-quantize and fall back to smaller models.

SLA / contractual asks: 
- Clear p95/p99 latency targets by model family and sequence length buckets (e.g., p95 < 250ms for short chat seq <=128 tokens; p99 < 1s for seq<=512 tokens).
- Throughput guarantee: reservation for baseline 200 reqs/s sustained with 2x burst headroom for 15 minutes during market opens.
- Credits for missed SLOs and runbook for capacity incidents.

Security / compliance notes:
- Requires SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence; encryption in-transit & at-rest; bring-your-own-KMS preferred; audit log retention 1 year.
- Data residency: customer data must remain in NA region for production workloads.
